# Harper's Bazaar

> > Harper's Bazaar is a leading fashion and culture magazine covering street style, celebrity fashion, British royals, film, and lifestyle trends.

Founded in 1867, Harper's Bazaar has been at the forefront of fashion journalism for over 150 years. The publication features coverage of fashion weeks, celebrity style icons like Kendall Jenner and Rihanna, cultural commentary on film and television, royal family updates, and lifestyle content ranging from travel to dining.

## Key Topics

- Street Style
- Fashion Week Coverage (New York, Paris, Milan, London)
- Celebrity Style (Kendall Jenner, Rihanna, Princess Diana)
- British Royal Family
- Seasonal Fashion Trends
- Outfit Ideas and Style Inspiration
- Work Outfits
- Classic Cinema and British Films
- Reality Television
- Travel and Dining
- Fashion Photography
- Celebrity Culture
- Cultural Commentary

## About Harper's Bazaar

- [History of Harper's Bazaar - 150th Anniversary of Harper's Bazaar](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/culture/features/a18658/history-of-harpers-bazaar/): Harper's Bazaar 150th anniversary history from 1867 founding to present

## Fashion and Style

- [Street Style 2026 - Street Fashion Photos, Inspiration, and Looks](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/fashion/street-style/): Street style photos featuring Kendall Jenner, Rihanna & fashion week looks

## Celebrity and Royal Coverage

- [Who Is Next in Line for the Throne If King Charles Dies? - Line of Succession 2024](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/celebrity/latest/g31928340/british-royals-line-of-succession/): British royal succession guide from King Charles III to Prince George

## Film and Television

- [24 Best English Movies of All Time - List of Classic British Films](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/culture/film-tv/g10214512/best-english-british-movies/): Curated list of 24 classic British films including Hitchcock's works
- [30 Best Reality Television Shows to Stream in 2025—Reality TV](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/culture/film-tv/g43875341/best-reality-tv-shows/): 30 top reality shows including The Kardashians, Love Island & The Bachelor

## Travel and Lifestyle

- [Best Desserts in NYC — Top Dessert Places in New York City](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/culture/travel-dining/a3615/new-yorks-best-dessert-bars/): NYC dessert guide covering Manhattan, Little Italy & viral treats
